episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Kim Noakes, a strange young misfit who was just a little girl when her father died in murky circumstances. Following his death, her mother Tina whisked her away to a remote rural life of seclusion and bizarre survival techniques.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Kim faces her dad's killer in an epic showdown, while Jay tells a disapproving Nicky that he plans to propose to his girlfriend Beth.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: After kidnapping her daughter, Tina and Kim must return to the gangster's mansion to stop Nicky and Jay's execution.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Unaware that she is being hunted by Jimmy's mysterious daughter, Kim fights back against her mother and demands they go for a trip - to the seaside.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Kim rebels against her mother's deception, while Tina decides to cut a deal for her safety. Jimmy's criminal associates continue their pursuit.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: The team retreat to the apparent safety of their desolate cabin, but Kim must deal with the betrayal she's suffered - and save her own life.
